request.style: English, male baritone, solo with choir, organ, flute, harp, cello, somber, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In days of Ahaz son of Jotham,
Rezin and Pekah marched to war,
Against Jerusalem they came to fight,
Yet they could not prevail then.

[Verse]
When word came to the house of David,
The heart of the king shook in fear,
Like trees of the forest before the wind,
The people trembled with dread then.

[Verse]
Go out to meet Ahaz at the pool,
At the end of the Upper Pool,
On the road to the Launderer's Field,
Be careful and keep calm now.

[Verse]
Do not lose heart over two stubs,
Of firewood that smolder and burn,
The fierce anger of Aram and Ephraim,
Will not succeed in their plan.

[Verse]
They plotted to tear Judah apart,
And set the son of Tabeel,
But the Lord GOD says it will not happen,
It will not take place then.

[Outro]
If you do not stand firm in faith
